entries.message: On iPhone and iPad, History, Archive and Downloads from a keyboard shortcut, the menu bar or the command palette slide a hidden floating sidebar in with that list. A docked iPad sidebar stays docked, and an iPhone showing its tabs full screen opens the list as a sheet instead of doing nothing.
On iPhone and iPad, scrolling or zooming the page puts a floating sidebar away, as tapping the page already did.
On iPhone and iPad, a floating sidebar has an arrow at its bottom corner that slides it back off the screen.
On iPhone and iPad, a tap at the edge of the screen no longer brings out a hidden sidebar; swipe in from the edge instead.
On iPhone, the address bar slides out of the way while you type into a page, such as filling in a form, and comes back when the keyboard goes.
